header.title: {{term}} admin leaving
header.description: Choose what happens to a {{term}}'s members when its admin's access is ended.

enabled.label: Remove members when the admin leaves
enabled.description: When a person ends the access of the last active admin of a {{term}}, its other members in that course lose access too: straight away on a hard terminate, or on the last access date on a soft cancel. Expired memberships are not affected.
